title: yaah workflow run --json report
description: JSON report emitted by 'yaah workflow run --json <spec>' (cmd/yaah/workflow_run.go, kind yaah.workflow.run.v1) after the document passed the validation gate and executed through the host door. A run REFUSED at the validation gate (error-severity findings, or any finding under --strict) reports the yaah.workflow.validate.v1 shape instead and never mints a run id: a run.v1 report always describes a run that reached the scheduler. All lists serialize as [] (never null). Exit code is 0 when ok is true and 1 otherwise.

spec.description: Spec path as given on the command line.

run_id.description: The run's label: --run-id when given, else minted from the graph name.

status.description: The scheduler's terminal verdict: succeeded = every node terminated succeeded or skipped; aborted = an error-severity node failure under the abort policy; failed = an exposed failure the run continued past (on_failure: continue); cancelled = Cancel or context end; budget_exceeded = a Limits axis ran out.

reason.description: The stopping cause: the aborting node, the exhausted budget axis, or the first exposed failure.

strict.description: Whether --strict was set at the validation gate.

dispatches.description: Dispatch attempts the run consumed against its budget.

outputs.description: Every recorded output binding in canonical node-path order: delegate reports and emit values.

nodes.description: Per-node terminal state in canonical order.

kind.description: One of the eleven IR kinds.

state.description: Lifecycle position; a terminal run leaves no node pending/ready/running.

reason.description: Why the node ended as it did (failure cause, skip source, refusal naming the owning bead).

artifacts.description: Artifacts the host door wrote for emit nodes under --artifact-root.

declared.description: The world-relative path as the document wrote it.

path.description: The host path it was resolved to under the artifact root.

warnings.description: Reducer warnings (e.g. an unevaluated when guard) and door warnings (e.g. a declined artifact write), sorted.

kind.description: The producing node's IR kind (delegate or emit in this bead).

name.description: The binding name: the declared output name, or the step id for an emit that declares none.

value.description: The delivered report text or rendered emit value. Per-field extraction from structured results is yaah-0u0v.13.

artifact_path.description: The declared artifact path, recorded whether or not it was written.

contract.description: The envelope's response-contract verdict (yaah-was9.2), verbatim; absent means the lane asserted none.
